import numpy as np
def make_case(n):
    i=np.arange(1,n+1,dtype=np.float64)
    bands=np.zeros((6,n),dtype=np.float64)
    bands[2]=5.0+0.2*np.sin(0.01*i)
    if n>=2:
        bands[1,1:]=0.6; bands[3,:-1]=-0.8
    if n>=3:
        bands[0,2:]=-0.1; bands[4,:-2]=0.15
    if n>=4:
        bands[5,:-3]=-0.05
    scale=1.0/np.sqrt(n)
    U=scale*np.column_stack((1+0.2*np.sin(0.017*i),0.7+0.15*np.cos(0.011*i)))
    V=scale*np.column_stack((0.9+0.1*np.cos(0.013*i),-0.6+0.12*np.sin(0.019*i)))
    W=scale*np.column_stack((0.8+0.18*np.sin(0.023*i),0.5+0.10*np.cos(0.029*i)))
    S=scale*np.column_stack((-0.7+0.11*np.cos(0.031*i),0.6+0.14*np.sin(0.037*i)))
    return bands,U,V,W,S
bands,U,V,W,S=make_case(8)
assert np.allclose((lambda o: (np.concatenate([np.asarray(o[0]["A_T_U"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[0]["S_tilde"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[0]["UU_lookup"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[0]["UW_lookup"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["J"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["K"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["E"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["X"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["Y"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o[1]["Z"]).reshape(-1)]).tolist()+[int(o[1]["k"])]) )(precompute_bps_quantities(bands,U,V,W,S)), target)

import numpy as np
n=4
bands=np.zeros((6,n)); bands[2]=5.; bands[1,1:]=.6; bands[3,:-1]=-.8

    p=p+np.outer(U[k],W[k]); UW[k]=p

       "X":np.zeros((2,2)),"Y":np.zeros((2,2)),"Z":np.zeros((2,5)),"k":0}
assert np.allclose((lambda o: np.concatenate([np.asarray(o["kbar"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o["bhat"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray([o["tau"],o["rkk"]]),np.asarray(o["qvec"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray(o["c"]).reshape(-1),np.asarray([o["rho"]])]).tolist())(form_structured_householder(bands,U,V,W,S,precomp,state)), target)
